::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Oct 6th 1888  
**From:** Elderfield  
**Manuscript:** MS Yale, Beinecke Library,  Osborn Files 41.21
:::

Dear Madam

I am exceedingly sorry for this, but I have nothing to do with those advertisements which are entirely [the publisher](people/person_744.qmd)’s affair [^1] I will send him your letter at once

yours truly
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: CMY's correspondent had evidently complained about the advertisement in *MP* of a book by  [Mary Ward](people/person_1467.qmd), whose *Robert Elsmere* was a novel about a clergyman's loss of faith. See below, letter to Innes (1 November 1888).
